notes.title: 2025-08-25 MAJOR UPDATE AND UPGRADE
notes.content: [h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171418/2315fd7372ba28defe601f589d653bb5d763cfa9.png"][/img][b]MAJOR UPDATE AND UPGRADE:[/b][/h1][p][b]Added IN-GAME rules, tips, notes, credits, acknowledgements, etc. Use the RULES button to select and cycle through the rules, guide, examples, and tips.[/b][/p][p][b]Added new "TWO TIMED GAMES" mode selectable with the GRID SIZE button.  This plays two timed 6 x 5 games (30 second timer) on the same cards with the players alternating who goes first.[/b][/p][p][b]Added QUESO-CHALLENGE mode to all language versions.[/b][/p][p][b]Fixed computer versus computer mode to allow different computer opponents to correctly play against one another.[/b][/p][p][b]Added Korean language version.[/b][/p][p][b]Improved text scaling.[/b][/p][p][b]Replaced some card backs.[/b][/p][p][b]Changed some default settings to more desirable options.[/b][/p][p][b]Removed a LOT of lag.[/b][/p][p][b]Some visual improvements and changes.[/b][/p][p][b]Some language translation improvements and changes.[/b][/p][p][b]All language versions now have the same features.[/b][/p]

notes.title: UPDATE NOTES FOR 2024-12-10 @ 12:27 PDT:
notes.content:
Added to English language version only:
(1) "QUESO-BOT CHALLENGE!" mode that tracks a player's per-session winning streak in the most difficult single player configuration - which is: Player 1 = QUESO-BOT; Player 2 = HUMAN; Grid = 6x5; and
(2) A "TIPS FOR PLAY" panel that gives a few tips for play and tells players how to start/enter "QUESO-BOT CHALLENGE!" mode. You can see this panel on the Start Screen (not during game play) by pressing or clicking on the RULES OF PLAY panel.

tags.feature: (1) "QUESO-BOT CHALLENGE!" mode that tracks a player's per-session winning streak in the most difficult single player configuration - which is: Player 1 = QUESO-BOT; Player 2 = HUMAN; Grid = 6x5;

(2) A "TIPS FOR PLAY" panel that gives a few tips for play and tells players how to start/enter "QUESO-BOT CHALLENGE!" mode. You can see this panel on the Start Screen (not during game play) by pressing or clicking on the RULES OF PLAY panel.
